title: Deebo Samuel's deal has a $4.1 million base, and up to $2.9 million in incentives

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Deebo Samuel's deal has a $4.1 million base, and up to $2.9 million in incentives
sources.description: The initial reports as to many NFL player contracts focus on the "up to" amount, since it's a bigger number — and it's usually the number that gets attached to the deal.
